mandatoryCriteria: Restore before deadline: POST /api/v1/cards/:cardId/restore succeeds when called strictly before restore_until (NOW() < restore_until)
State transition: Transitions card state back to active; clears deleted_at and restore_until
Preserve identity and contents: Restores card with identical id, title, description, assignees, comments, and images
Board version increment: Increments board structure_version and snapshot_version
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Card restoration prior to deadline.
